title: Organized brass bands, their size, uniforms and instruments
summary: He describes the organized parade bands, their size, uniforms and instrumentation.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Tell me some more about the parade, the brass bands uptown. Were they big organized bands or just little pick up groups?

Well, most, you see like Bebe Risley, he had an organized band and also Kid O'Re had an organized band. On the street through the march, you know, you mean? Yeah, well they paraded too, like you know on advertising and parade around. Yeah, they did all of that also. And Jack Carey, he had an organized band. That's a good trombone man. Mm-hmm.
Don't have any pieces that they use. And those.
He used to use seven pieces with the piano. Out on the street? On the street six, not less than six. You mean on an advertised or a parade?

Oh, the brass band. Oh, twelve, fourteen, sixteen pieces like that. Oh yes, oh yes, oh yes. Twelve, fifteen, sixteen pieces. But I thought you meant on the advertised on the float like we advertise around. Yeah. Yeah, I played quite a few of them.
We'll talk about them later too. I was wondering more about those brass bands.
Did they all have uniforms in those days?
Yes, you see the brass band, you always had to have a uniform, you know, to show the parade. Quite natural, yes.
Usually wear coats though too? Now they don't wear coats anymore.
Well they had coats then. You had on the whole blue suit, you know, the whole blue suit, sure. Mm-hmm, those days.
And now all they wear is a cap and their dark pants and a white shirt.
Oh yeah, yeah, that's right now.
Remember about which instruments they had in the brass band?

Well they had... How many of each? How many? Well, on trumpet, they'd always have round about three trumpets. And on the trombone, two or three trombones. On the clarinets, two or three of those. Two or three of each, you know, brass.
Did they ever use saxophones in those days?
Sometime, yeah, sometime. Mm-hmm, yeah, the alto. Sometime. And mostly only one tuba though. Yeah. One tuba man and one kill drum. Bass drum. Bass drum.
